author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
After I experiment with AI manga and anime generation for about 2 weeks, I have to admit it is hard, and there lots of things to learn, even I have Fable and Astra at my command.

The good thing is I watch lots of managa and anime knowing what AI generated is slop.

Maybe AI won't change the world that much after all. AI can write code, but most people don't want to write their software and generate non slop software is still hard work.

I could generate my own anime, but it is just for curiousity and exploration, I still prefer simply watching a good show without doing the hard work first.
